facts.label: focus
facts.value: AI plumbing, security middleware, multi-tenant systems

about.tagline: Final-year CS student shipping production tools — a multi-tenant AI POS and an open-source ASGI security middleware on PyPI.
paragraphs: I'm Brian. Final-year Computer Science student at INTI International University, working across mobile (Flutter), backend (FastAPI / SQLAlchemy), and applied AI (YOLO, LLM function calling).

My flagship work is two things. GEYAM — an AI-powered multi-tenant restaurant POS with real-time food tray recognition via fine-tuned YOLO, plus an LLM assistant that answers natural-language questions about live sales through function calling. And Antsilk — a drop-in ASGI security middleware published to PyPI that protects FastAPI apps with rate limiting, WAF pattern scanning, JWT validation, and structured attack logging in two lines of install.

I like building things that fail loudly, ship in a single docker compose, and explain themselves in a README. CAPM-certified. Currently looking for internships in software engineering, AI/ML, or backend infrastructure.

projects.name: GEYAM
projects.tagline: AI-powered multi-tenant restaurant POS with live vision + LLM assistant.
projects.description: Cross-platform POS with multi-tenant isolation, real-time food tray recognition via a fine-tuned YOLO model, and an LLM assistant ("GEYAM, tell me sales today") that uses function calling to query live transactions. Integrated Billplz payments and deployed end-to-end with custom DNS via Cloudflare.

projects.name: Antsilk
projects.tagline: Open-source ASGI security middleware for FastAPI — two lines to install.
projects.description: Drop-in Python library that protects ASGI apps with bundled rate limiting, WAF pattern scanning, JWT validation, and structured attack logging. Two-line install. Published to PyPI; deployed on Geyam in production for live attack telemetry.

projects.name: brianchenhao.com
projects.tagline: This site, v2. 3D head-tracking character, scroll animation, Gemini-backed chat.
projects.description: Single-page React + Vite portfolio with a rigged GLB whose head bone follows the cursor and Motion-driven animation throughout. The chat box is backed by a Supabase Edge Function that rate-limits per IP via Postgres and proxies to Gemini — no servers to keep alive. Frontend hosted on Vercel.
